model: Run any LLM (anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5) for the visual concept, then Seedream 5 Lite (generate:bytedance_seedream_v5_lite) x2 at landscape_16_9: hero (no text) and share card (edit of the hero, title added)

inputs.style_note: text, up to 2000 characters, the blog's shared look: medium, palette, mood
